messages:
zoe: FYI repro of a weird embeddings parity bug between node and python sampleapps. node path base64-encodes concatenated Float32 buffers and in some runs the server rejects with `400 vector length mismatch: expected 1024 got 1019`. then our sampleapp retry middleware re-sends the batch -> duplicates.

zoe: minimal snippet that hits it:
```js
const raw = Buffer.concat(vecs.map(v => Buffer.from(new Float32Array(v).buffer)));
const b64 = raw.toString('base64'); // sometimes final bytes appear trimmed on our test harness
await fetch('/embed', { body: JSON.stringify({model, data: b64}) });
```

mike: curious whether the base64 encoder ever drops trailing zeros when converting buffers to strings in our environment. Node toString('base64') shouldn't. Is there any intermediate JSON stringify that trims?

zoe: i compared lengths before and after: pre-encode bytes=4096, post-decode bytes=4091 in failing run. so 5 bytes lost. python path always preserved length.

anya: two fixes: 1) SDK-level validation: reject if vector.length != expectedDim (or expose pad/truncate modes). 2) sampleapp should not treat all 4xx as retryable. structural 400s must be fatal.

mike: agreed. also enhance server error payload to include a `non_retryable: true` flag for structural validation errors so clients/agents can auto-honor it. i'll open a small RFC.

dev-bot: created issue DEVEX-1122: "client-side vector validation + narrow 4xx retry rules"

ci-bot: mike opened PR #820: "sampleapp: avoid retry on vector-dim errors; js-sdk: validate vectors before send". CI: tests pending.

zoe: temp workaround: padVectors(vecs, expectedDim) locally so tests pass, but i agree we shouldn't silently mutate inputs by default.

anya: add an integration test that runs node+python sampleapps against a tiny local server and compares output shapes and ids. add to CI matrix to catch parity regressions. include fuzzing of base64 path.

mike: heads-up for billing: retry-induced duplicates could overbill customers. i'll ping finance to check spikes.

zoe: adding minimal repro gist and a failing cURL. will attach to the PR. thanks for the quick triage everyone. :rocket:
